Notes: Extra objects for Ravenwood (ZoneObjects.cs explains the fields).

Objects.Name: Imlight Ravenwood Cyclops Lane Tower Sigil
Objects.Notes: Niduus, 2026-10-21: a 4 player sigil at X -2340 Y 4812 Z -28, Rotation 3.851 (220.6 degrees), Width 1; then turned a quarter turn left. A copy of Cyclops Lane's Street 3 Tower 1 Instance Sigil (template 107081, Teleport Semi Circle 4 Player Generic), lit (Glowy, the pad's On). Niduus, 2026-10-21: it now sends the player into a private copy of the top of the Darkmoor Mausoleum, where Malistaire the Undying is fought, loaded with the RavenwoodMalistaire variant (G14_DM-Interiors-DM_Z08_I01_MausoleumTop@RavenwoodMalistaire.json). The spot is the zone's own Start (where the Mausoleum's lower floor sends players up). The name is kept so the sigil keeps its global id.

Objects.Name: Imlight Ravenwood Shadow Portal
Objects.Notes: Niduus, 2026-10-22: the Shadow Portal by the Malistaire sigil, for looks only. It is the house furniture's own model (SP_Teleporter_Shadow, template 1719467, House_TeleporterRevamp_Shadow.nif); Empyrea's zone stand-in for it is EM_StandIn_ShadowPortal (1448169), a second model to swap to by TemplateID if the furniture does not show. It stands about 550 behind the sigil and faces the same way. Move or turn it in the Manager's Customs tab (Custom areas): the server moves it at once; those changes are kept in spiraldb-extra/Customs/Placements.json, over the values here.
